pages.text: Perhaps the most unpleasant place I've encountered so far. There's almost nothing to do here-no food, no water, although it's relatively safe on the surface. Once I saw a figure nearly 3 meters tall, but I didn't have the courage to approach it. The strange thing is, I saw several hatches leading deep underground. There was a terrible smell coming from them, along with clicking and chittering sounds.
I definitely should NOT (crossed out) crawl into them.
